title: Annotatio II §.V close: Burmann concession — spiritual manducation too; stop before Berengar-confuter inventors
pass_a_gloss: Just as likewise it is to be granted to Burmann that Radbertus taught Christ’s Flesh is also eaten spiritually in the Sacrament of the Supper, and the blood drunk spiritually (chs. 5, 6, 10, 20).
pass_b_english: Concede to Burmann likewise: Radbertus also teaches spiritual eating of the flesh and spiritual drinking of the blood in the Supper sacrament.
Stop before Berengar’s confuters as inventors of crassior/subtilior (Rupert of Deutz &c.).
source_text: Quemadmodum similiter Burmanno largiendum, docuisse Rhadebertum, Carnem Christi etiam spiritualiter manducari in Sacramento Coenae, & sanguinem spiritualiter potari, cap. 5. 6. 10. 20.
notes: Spiritual manducation; stop before Rupert inventors.
